fullPassage: Until a few decades ago, most of the world's coffee and cocoa were shade-grown under a canopy of large forest trees. Recently, however, new varieties of both crops have been developed that can be grown in full sun. Because more coffee or cocoa trees can be crowded into these fields, and they get more solar energy than in a shaded plantation, yields for sun-grown crops are higher. There are costs, however, in this new technology. Sun-grown trees die earlier from the stress and diseases common in these fields. In addition, scientists have found that the number of bird species can be cut in half in full-sun plantations, and the number of individual birds may be reduced by 90 percent. Shade-grown coffee and cocoa generally require fewer pesticides because the birds and insects residing in the forest canopy eat many of the pests.

❌ ② these fields: 그늘 재배가 아닌 sun-grown 밭을 지칭, '재배 장소'가 아니라 결과 배경
❌ ③ forest canopy: 그늘 재배의 숲 지붕, 신품종의 재배 조건과 반대
❌ ④ shaded plantation: 그늘 농장, 옛 재배 방식 — 신품종 조건과 반대
det.tip: new varieties + can be grown in __________ — 그늘 재배의 반대는 full sun

questions.passage: Until a few decades ago, most of the world's coffee and cocoa were shade-grown under a canopy of large forest trees. Recently, however, new varieties of both crops have been developed that can be grown in full sun. Because more coffee or cocoa trees can be crowded into these fields, and they get more solar energy than in a shaded plantation, yields for sun-grown crops are higher. There are costs, however, in this new technology. Sun-grown trees die earlier from the stress and diseases common in these fields. In addition, scientists have found that the number of bird species can be cut in half in full-sun plantations, and the number of individual birds may be reduced by 90 percent. Shade-grown coffee and cocoa generally require __________ because the birds and insects residing in the forest canopy eat many of the pests.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: fewer pesticides(더 적은 농약) — 새 자연 포식자(새/곤충)가 해충을 먹어 주기에 농약이 덜 필요함
det.analysis:
❌ ① higher yields: 더 높은 수확량, 태양 재배의 장점이지 그늘 재배의 농약 맥락 아님
❌ ② new varieties: 신품종, 재배 방식 결과 아님
❌ ③ individual birds: 개별 새들, 주어이지 목적어 아님
✅ ④ fewer pesticides: 원문 일치, 자연 포식자 효과의 결론
det.tip: Shade-grown + require __________ because the birds eat pests → fewer pesticides
